--- prompt ---
Perspective-corrected top-down photo of a real breadboard. Hole column numbers 1 to N are written above and below the photo and row letters are written at its left and right edges, each aligned with its line of holes. The board has rows a-e, a centre channel, rows f-j, and four power rails (the long strips along its two long edges, rows +/-). Detect every component and every jumper wire. For each give its type, a value guess, conf (0 to 1), and box_2d [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax] normalized to 0-1000 over this whole image (the margin included) that encloses the whole item INCLUDING all its metal leads down to where they enter the board (leads may span many columns). Ignore hands, probes and tools.
Also give leads: where each metal lead (or wire tip) disappears into the plastic of the board, not where the body is, as {"pin":"1","point":[y,x]} with point normalized to 0-1000 over this whole image. List every jumper wire, even one whose other end leaves the photo or is hidden; give only the end(s) you can see. Lead counts: resistor, led, capacitor, diode and button 2 (both ends); wire 2 (both ends you can see; 1 if the other end leaves the photo); potentiometer 3; ic: point only at pin 1 (pin "1") and at the last pin on pin 1's side of the chip (pin "4" of 8, "7" of 14, "8" of 16). For an ic also give pins (8, 14 or 16), notch (which side of the image the notch or dot is on: left, right, or unsure) and label (the printed text, or null).
Also read the power rails: the long strips along the board's two long edges, each marked with a printed + or - (often a red or blue line). Name them by side using the board's printed row letters: aOuter is the strip farthest from row a, aInner the strip between it and row a, jInner the strip next to row j, jOuter the strip farthest from row j. Give each one's printed sign: "+", "-", or "?" if you can't read it.
If there is no breadboard in the photo, answer {"visible":false,"items":[]}.
Short JSON only: {"items":[{"type":"resistor|led|capacitor|ic|button|battery|diode|transistor|potentiometer|other|wire","value":"220 or null","conf":0.8,"box_2d":[ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax],"leads":[{"pin":"1","point":[y,x]},{"pin":"2","point":[y,x]}],"pins":8,"notch":"left|right|unsure","label":"TL072 or null"}],"rails":{"aOuter":"+","aInner":"-","jInner":"+","jOuter":"-"}}
(pins, notch and label only for an ic.)
